conceptual_delta: Connect prior ChatGPT research, canonical HSWM source snapshots, public literature, explicit unresolved obligations and one real DGX observation. Research proposals become queryable claims with sources and scope, not implementation evidence.
identity: HSWM is one large AI organized as a hypergraph neural network, with LLM-function computation as its basic unit and operation through hypergraph Semantic Weight. The large semantic hypergraph is AI state; local LLM execution is an internal operator. KG here is a bounded research projection, not that cognition.

prior_research.title: Hyperon comparator and persistent n-ary storage
prior_research.proposal: Qualify Classic AtomSpace plus RocksStorageNode as a storage adapter candidate; retain Hyperon/MeTTa as mandatory architecture comparator.
prior_research.limitation: Classic AtomSpace storage is not automatically a Hyperon capability. RocksDB use alone does not establish atomic durable HSWM revisions; exact missing source pins remain unqualified.
prior_research.next: Test repeated role occurrences, immutable branches, read-set conflicts and old-or-new revision recovery at exact component commits.

prior_research.title: Durable TypeScript execution and uncertain delivery
prior_research.proposal: Consider DBOS only if existing Effect execution lacks required recovery; reuse workflow infrastructure.
prior_research.limitation: Disabling retries alone does not guarantee at-most-once external delivery. The proposed send right and receipt reconciliation were not tested.
prior_research.next: Inject crashes around durable send-right acquisition, external acceptance and receipt recording; preserve UNKNOWN without automatic replay.

prior_research.title: Bounded LLM operator transport
prior_research.proposal: Qualify a single-call AI SDK or existing Effect adapter for local typed inputs and outputs.
prior_research.limitation: Schema-conforming output does not establish semantic correctness. Reported, estimated and unknown usage/model identity must remain distinct.
prior_research.next: Compare existing adapter first on malformed JSON, missing usage, timeout, context overflow and no hidden retry; then run bounded live inference.

prior_research.title: Temporal memory as a derived query projection
prior_research.proposal: Consider Graphiti for isolated retrieval over existing Neo4j; Hindsight is a separate alternative.
prior_research.limitation: Temporal retrieval is neither canonical state nor exact restore. Re-extraction or re-embedding is not a byte-preserving restoration.
prior_research.next: Test valid-time/known-time queries, late corrections, role occurrences and restoration without LLM extraction.

prior_research.title: N-ary graph interoperability
prior_research.proposal: Reuse the Neo4j driver and explicit relation/role occurrences; use RDF for exchange and SHACL validation, TypeDB as a role-relation comparator.
prior_research.limitation: Flat pair edges can lose roles and repeated participants. SHACL validates declared structure, not permission, concurrency or truth.
prior_research.next: Round-trip repeated participants, ordered roles, exact revisions and large integers; verify fresh reads with backend-specific fences.

prior_research.title: External evaluation reuse
prior_research.proposal: Qualify Inspect as external evaluator and ALFWorld as a possible text environment; evaluate HSWM as one system.
prior_research.limitation: A model-based score alone is not independent environment success. No benchmark was run by the prior research answer.
prior_research.next: Freeze evaluator, outcomes, model and budgets, and verify the whole-system bridge and actual generation settings before comparison.

prior_research.title: Observability and experiment provenance
prior_research.proposal: Consider Effect/OpenTelemetry with MLflow; Phoenix remains an alternative rather than an assumed heavier system.
prior_research.limitation: Trace collection is a derived observation surface, not canonical state or causal credit. Operational cost was not measured.
prior_research.next: Verify exact trace/artifact linkage, missing fields and private-data handling using existing storage before deploying a new service.

prior_research.title: Causal analysis and statistical contracts
prior_research.proposal: Reuse DoWhy for identification, estimation and refutation; start with a fixed sample protocol.
prior_research.limitation: An analysis package does not supply treatment assignment, state restoration or causal identifiability. Sequential confidence tools have separate assumptions.
prior_research.next: Validate null and known-effect fixtures, paired assignment, missing outcomes, restored state and cache controls before efficacy estimation.

prior_research.title: Feedback optimizers as candidate generators
prior_research.proposal: Consider GEPA as a bounded revision proposal/search engine with HSWM-owned evaluation and admission.
prior_research.limitation: DSPy GEPA and independent GEPA are not independent algorithms. Optimizer score improvement is not canonical outcome-bound learning.
prior_research.next: Separate development, selection and sealed evaluation; compare frozen, prompt-only and typed-revision candidates at declared total budgets.

prior_research.title: Composition and revision search frontier
prior_research.proposal: Qualify OpenHands as a replaceable proposal executor; use DGM ideas for candidate lineage, not automatic promotion.
prior_research.limitation: Agent orchestration does not establish HSWM recursive cognition. No candidate was shown to satisfy all HSWM composition contracts.
prior_research.next: Check typed deltas, stale read sets, independent evaluation, exceptions and shared budgets before two-cell behavioral comparisons.

prior_research.title: Minimal integration stack
prior_research.proposal: Keep the existing HSWM/Effect core and add one missing capability at a time; evaluate with Inspect and common tracing.
prior_research.limitation: This is a conditional design synthesis, not evidence that AI SDK, DBOS, Graphiti or another service is installed or necessary.
prior_research.next: First inspect the existing pinned runtime; exercise one model, one local transition and one revision before introducing infrastructure.

prior_research.title: Minimum qualification and evidence integrity
prior_research.proposal: Reuse fast-check for contract exploration and in-toto/SLSA for artifact integrity where those capabilities are needed.
prior_research.limitation: Signed evidence does not prove its content true. Mock contract checks do not establish HSWM efficacy; no new package is adopted here.
prior_research.next: Test six declared fault classes, bounded generated traces, uncertain delivery and fresh restored reads before a bounded model trial.

jev_claims.title: Jev launch date
jev_claims.text: The TypeSafe introduction is dated 2026-09-15, five days before this review, rather than 2026-09-20.

jev_claims.title: Typed decision primitives
jev_claims.text: Jev exposes Choice, Score and Noul primitives and parallel decisions. A typed probability/concentration output is not a natural-language reasoning trace.

jev_claims.title: Concentration versus correctness confidence
jev_claims.text: The documented confidence describes concentration of the model output distribution. It is not automatically the probability of factual correctness or causal evidence mass.

jev_claims.title: RLCD description and undisclosed recipe
jev_claims.text: TypeSafe calls its method Reinforcement Learning for Calibrated Decisions. Reviewed official sources do not disclose an exact architecture, base model, parameter count, training corpus, loss/reward/optimizer recipe or model weights; no Jev technical paper was located in the reviewed search scope.

jev_claims.title: Vendor benchmarks are not HSWM evidence
jev_claims.text: Reported workflow latency/cost advantages are vendor-specific observations, including model-derived target labels. They do not establish independent task truth or equal-budget HSWM improvement.

papers.title: Beyond Binary Rewards: Training LMs to Reason About Their Uncertainty
papers.finding: RLCR combines answer correctness with a proper scoring penalty on verbalized confidence; the paper studies reasoning models, not Jev.
papers.transfer: Candidate calibration comparator. No source establishes that Jev RLCD derives from RLCR.

papers.title: On Calibration of Modern Neural Networks
papers.finding: Studies neural probability miscalibration and temperature scaling on the evaluated classifiers.
papers.transfer: Evaluate calibration separately from output concentration; no automatic transfer to semantic or causal weights.

papers.title: Language Models (Mostly) Know What They Know
papers.finding: Studies self-evaluation and probabilities of knowing or answering correctly, with distribution and generalization limits.
papers.transfer: A comparison for correctness confidence, not proof that an LLM knows ground truth.

papers.title: Training language models to follow instructions with human feedback
papers.finding: Describes supervised demonstrations, preference models and reinforcement learning for instruction following.
papers.transfer: Historical contributor background only; not Jev's undisclosed training recipe.

standards.title: RDF 1.1 Concepts
standards.use: Stable graph exchange semantics; local HSWM predicate vocabulary is explicitly separate.

standards.title: PROV-O
standards.use: Source entities, derivation activities and generated exchange artifacts; provenance does not establish truth.

standards.title: SHACL 1.0
standards.use: Structural cardinality, datatypes, evidence links and bounded assertion requirements.

standards.title: SPARQL 1.1 Query
standards.use: Competency queries over claims, sources, observed outcomes and open obligations.

standards.title: Defining N-ary Relations on the Semantic Web
standards.use: Relation instances and explicit role occurrences; occurrence identity and ordinal are HSWM-local additions.
